items.title: 5.3 Stress, strain aur Young's modulus (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.3 with Fig. 5.3 and Table 5.1 (PDF 96-97).

blocks.text: Mechanical tests ke results (nateeje) aam taur par stress aur strain mein bataye jate hain. Yeh dono lagai gayi force aur deformation (shakal ka bigarna) se define hote hain.
Stress
Kisi object ki shakal, volume ya lambai badalne ke liye per unit area (har ek square metre par) jo force lagai jaye use stress kehte hain. Formula:

Stress (σ) ka SI unit newton per square metre (N m⁻²) hai, jise pascal (Pa) kehte hain. Stress se lambai, volume ya shakal badal sakti hai. Jo stress lambai badle use tensile stress, jo volume badle use volume stress, aur jo shakal badle use shear stress kehte hain.
Strain

Strain batata hai ke stress lagne par solid mein kitni deformation hui. Ek dimension (sirf lambai) mein deformation ho to strain lambai mein fractional change (asal lambai ke muqable change ka hissa) hai. Agar ΔL lambai mein change aur L₀ asal lambai ho (Fig. 5.3 (a)), to:

blocks.text_alt: Strain (ε) = Change in length (ΔL) / Original length (L₀)   (5.2)

blocks.alt: Lambai L ki gulabi bar ko dono siron par force F bahar ki taraf khenchti hai. Dono siron se aage dotted drawings dikhate hain ke bar kitni khinchi.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.3(a): Tensile strain (kitab ki Figure 5.3(a) ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Strain do lambaiyon ki ratio (ek ka doosre se muqabla) hai, is liye is ki koi dimension aur koi unit nahi. Agar strain ε tensile stress σ (kheenchne wale stress) se ho to use tensile strain kehte hain; agar compressive stress σ (dabane wale stress) se ho to compressive strain.
Jab stress volume badle to har unit volume mein volume ki change ko volumetric strain kehte hain (Fig. 5.3 (b)):

blocks.alt: Ek cube ka drawing aur us ke andar chhota dashed cube. Laal teer F har face par andar dabate hain: oopar, neeche, baen, daen, aage aur peechhe. Wavy (lehrdar) lines ek face ko A, bahar wale cube ko Volume V aur andar wale dashed cube ko Volume V - delta V batati hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.3(b): Volumetric strain (kitab ki Figure 5.3(b) ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har face par barabar force F andar dabati hai, is liye cube ki shakal wahi rehti hai lekin volume V₀ se ghat kar V₀ − ΔV reh jata hai. Volumetric strain = ΔV/V₀.

Farz karein ek rigid body (sakht cheez jo shakal na badle) ke do aamne saamne faces ka faasla y hai (Fig. 5.3 (c)). Shear stress lagne se ek face Δx faasla phisal (slide ho) jata hai. Is se shear strain γ paida hota hai:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne equation 5.4 mein Δx/y aur tan θ ke beech “=” ka nishan nahi chhapa, is liye woh multiply jaisi lagti hai. Sahi equation γ = Δx/y = tan θ hai, kyun ke Fig. 5.3(c) mein tan θ = Δx/y hai.

blocks.alt: Grey block jis ka neeche ka hissa jura hua hai, daen taraf jhuka hai. Us ki orange oopri surface A par force F daen taraf lagti hai. Jure kone se oonchai y ki seedhi khari line uthti hai; oopar ka kinara us se delta x aage phisal gaya hai, aur khari line aur tirchhe kinare ke beech angle (kona) theta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.3(c): Shear strain (kitab ki Figure 5.3(c) ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Oopar wala face Δx phisalta hai jabke oonchai y hai; is liye tan θ = Δx/y. Chhote angle ke liye tan θ ≈ θ, is liye shear strain = θ.
Agar angle θ chhota ho aur radian mein napa jaye to tan θ ≈ θ, is liye:
Young's Modulus

blocks.title: Young's modulus
blocks.text: Per unit strain jo stress lagaya jaye use Young's modulus kehte hain.

blocks.text_alt: i.e. Y = Tensile stress / Tensile strain

blocks.text: Young's modulus ka unit wahi hai jo stress ka, yani N m⁻² ya Pa. Different (alag alag) materials ke Young's modulus Table 5.1 mein diye gaye hain.
Wire ka Young's modulus maloom karne ke kai tareeqe hain; un mein se ek Searle's method hai (5.4 dekhein).

blocks.title: For Your Information
blocks.text: Is ka naam 19th century ke British scientist Thomas Young ke naam par hai, lekin yeh concept 1727 mein Leonhard Euler ne pesh kiya tha.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne naam ghalat chhape hain: “Thames Young” ki jagah Thomas Young aur “Euller” ki jagah Euler hona chahiye.

blocks.caption: Table 5.1: Kuch materials ke elastic constants

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Table mein mercury aur pani ka Young's modulus aur shear modulus 0 hai, kyun ke liquids ki apni koi lambai ya shakal nahi hoti; un ka sirf bulk modulus (volume dabne ko rokna) hota hai.

blocks.caption: Stress aur strain ki teen qismein

blocks.prompt: 2 m lambi aur 2 × 10⁻⁶ m² cross-section area wali steel wire 400 N se kheenchi jati hai. Y = 2 × 10¹¹ N m⁻² ho to extension nikalein. Phir 3 m lambi, 1 × 10⁻⁶ m² area wali copper wire par 500 N force lage to stress aur strain nikalein (copper ka Y Table 5.1 se 110 × 10⁹ N m⁻²).
blocks.explanation: Y = (F/A)/(ΔL/L₀) se ΔL = F L₀ / (A Y) = (400 × 2) / (2 × 10⁻⁶ × 2 × 10¹¹) = 800 / (4 × 10⁵) = 0.002 m = 2 mm. Copper: stress = F/A = 500 / (1 × 10⁻⁶) = 5 × 10⁸ N m⁻²; strain = stress / Y = 5 × 10⁸ / (1.1 × 10¹¹) ≈ 4.5 × 10⁻³ (koi unit nahi).

blocks.text: Summary (khulasa)

items: Stress σ = F/A (unit N m⁻² = Pa): tensile (lambai), volume, shear (shakal).
Strain (koi unit nahi): ΔL/L₀ (tensile ya compressive), volumetric ΔV/V₀, shear γ = Δx/y = tan θ ≈ θ.
Young's modulus Y = (F/A)/(ΔL/L₀), unit Pa (steel 200, copper 110, heera 1120, sab × 10⁹ N m⁻²; liquids ka Y = 0).
